$comment: Single source of truth for Tessera's enforced performance budgets. Both perf gates read this file: scripts/coldStartGate.cjs (coldStartMs) and scripts/perfBudgets.mjs (interaction.*). All values are milliseconds. Budgets are boot/render-to-ready ceilings, set with headroom over the observed median on the CI reference runner so normal jitter never flakes the gate but a real regression (roughly >1.8x) trips it. To re-baseline after an intentional change, run `npm run perf:budgets` locally, read the reported medians, and bump the relevant ceiling here in the same PR with a one-line rationale in the commit.
